summary: Solowin Holdings filed a Form 6-K disclosing the issuance of Pre-Paid Purchase #2 (PPP #2) to Streeterville Capital, LLC under an existing Securities Purchase Agreement. PPP #2 has a principal amount of $6.48M including a $480K original issue discount, with a purchase price of $6M, interest at 8% per annum, and is unsecured. The proceeds are for working capital. It allows monthly amortization payments of $900K, and upon default, the investor may require share issuance at 85% of market price. A Side Letter also provides for issuance of 1M additional shares at $0.0001 per share. This is a routine financing transaction, not a special situation.
